what: When a cell of the horizontally flowing character row enters the central 70% of the screen, the speech bubble above its head pops out from 10px below and scale 0 with .4s back.out(1.7). Up to two show at once: when a third appears, the earliest one folds away in .25s, neighboring cells never show together, and each cell shows only once.

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell (one cell of the flowing row) — required
options.max: Number of speech bubbles floating at once, default 2
options.side: Width trimmed from both sides of the screen, default 15% (so it sits in the middle 70%)

note: Flowing the lines is up to the consumer (a marquee part or a CSS animation). This part only shows speech bubbles. If the lines do not flow, only the two center cells appear.

from.where: index.js [data-tips] speech bubbles for the character row in the product section (original q(): IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 -15%, fromTo autoAlpha·scale 0·y 10 → .4s back.out(1.7), up to two at once, skips neighbors, plays once).
